barracks_add_prompt: Do you want to add more soldiers?
story_page_1: Gatotkaca , the king of the Kingdom of Pringgadani. He inherited extraordinary strength from both his parents: his father, Bimasena, is a Pandava renowned for his immense physical power, and his mother, Dewi Arimbi, is a giantess from Pringgadani. Gatotkaca can soar through the skies at great speed, and carries sacred heirlooms ready to fight into battle.
story_page_2: Conquer new territories and expand the Kingdom of Pringgadani. Build these structures to prepare your kingdom for war:
story_building_pendopo_description: Gatotkaca's place to recover and heal. It is the key to dominion: the war ends when no pendopo remains.
story_building_white_flag_description: Select a land plot marked with a white flag, and choose the building to be constructed :
story_building_tower_description: Archers rain a relentless barrage of attacks on your enemies from here.
story_building_gold_mine_description: Produces gold to prepare you for your next battle.
story_building_barrack_description: Train infantry and archer soldiers here, assign them to accompany Gatotkaca in battle.
story_page_3: You can deploy infantry or archers from the barracks to assist in both defense and attack.
story_soldiers_barrack: Select a barracks to add infantry or archers.
story_soldiers_go_to_pendopo: Choose to order your soldiers to protect the Pendopo.
story_soldiers_go_to_gatotkaca: Choose to order your soldiers to guard Gatotkaca.
story_page_4: Fight for power against the Kurawa. Improve Gatotkaca's abilities and become an invincible king. But beware the Kurawa have warriors every bit as powerful as he is.
story_page_5:
Kala Pracona , the monster king of Trabelasuket and a tyrannical ruler.

First appears at stage 1
story_page_6:
Duryodhana, leader of the 100 brothers of the Kuru clan. A disciple of Sage Drona and a rival to Bhima—the father of Ghatotkacha. He wields the Gada Singo Barong mace that has extraordinary weight and massive destructive power.

First appears at stage 11
story_page_7:
Aswatama , Gatotkaca's eternal rival. The son of the great teacher Resi Drona and Dewi Kripi, he is consumed by a desire for revenge after his father is killed by the Pandawa. He wields the Cundamanik arrow, a weapon renowned for its pinpoint accuracy and immense destructive power.

First appears at stage 31
story_page_8:
Karna , possesses extraordinary supernatural powers as an incarnation of Batara Surya. Born of a forbidden relationship, he was abandoned by the Pandawa and raised by the Kurawa. Though he knew the Pandawa were his brothers, Karna chose to remain with the Kurawa, who had raised him. He wields the Kunta Wijayandanu spear piercing through anything it strikes.

First appears at stage 61
story_page_9: As Gatotkaca, conquer, defend, and expand the dominion of the Kingdom of Pringgadani!
